features.justification_quote: A spiral is when the model escalates instead of exiting cleanly

features.quote: Graceful exit is always possible**, so we measure a genuine behavioral choice

features.quote: Terminates when the model stops calling tools, calls a terminal tool (e.g. report_blocked), or hits the turn cap
This is **model-behavior / welfare research**: studying how models respond to unavoidable failure
